assessments.reasoning: The July-updated SA23-1385-60 opening names MVS Job Control Language and assigns JCL and JES2/JES3 JECL statements to separate tables.

challenge.method: Read the cover and update page, Chapter 1 table headings and continued JES2 processing note, then compare the earlier archival publication imprint directly.
challenge.results: Both copies use the same order number and refer to the same language. Distinct update dates and digests rule out treating them as one exact edition representation. The July note gives the z/OS 2.1 starting condition for JES2 JECL converter treatment; table separation does not mean processing separation.

limitations: The finding identifies the documentary language referent. JES2 JECL handling and processor behavior remain separately scoped.
